coverage.meaning: Coverage and referenced locations checked; not a certificate of all formulas, runtime, or edge.

causal_clocks.current_news: Producer writes guarded joint_news_current_v1.json with as_of_utc evidence time, generated_utc after computation and source hashes. Consumer rereads/verifies it and stores a later first_observed_epoch=news_available_epoch; member observed_available_utc is raised to at least that observation. Evidence<=generated<=observation; evidence age must remain <=300 seconds. Current frame e is this actual consumer observation, not the price bar start.
causal_clocks.fit_and_target: For training anchor t, exact P(t+3600) must exist, t+3600<=price cutoff and both endpoints must share a session. Its close matures at t+3660; news frame matures at t+60. Anchors are UTC epoch multiples of 900 seconds. Historical label y=(P(t+3600)-P(t))/pip is a training target, not one of the 34 inputs.
causal_clocks.historical_news: Retained original classified members come from source_events joined to committed fast-lane mappings and independently read visibility records. Their payload/hash, visibility contract, trusted observation flag and supported original classifier version (v164 or v165) are checked. Availability=max(mapping_visible_epoch,member.observed_available_utc); the latter is at least mapping visibility. Historical frames use e=t+60, mapping<=e and known_m in [e-3600,e]. They do not reclassify mutable article tables into earlier history.
causal_clocks.news: Original member knowledge known_m=max(published_utc,first_seen_utc,causal_known_utc,detail_available_utc,numeric_causal_known_utc,publication_clock_known_utc) over present fields. It excludes later mapping/consumption when computing age and original expiry. Frame admission also requires a separate availability<=e.
causal_clocks.original_expiry: The guard sets each admitted member expiry to known_m + estimated_reaction_horizon_minutes*60. Availability includes observed_available_utc, but that later clock never moves original expiry. Within a claim expiry is the earliest representative expiry; across pair-relevant vetted groups the feature uses the earliest again. Capture expiry is min(news_evidence_epoch+300, earliest vetted pair expiry), or evidence+300 with no vetted group.
causal_clocks.price: The CSV key is the UTC M1 start. P(t) is complete no earlier than t+60; stable-read consumer observation is retained separately and may be later. Current capture and computation require the latest close to be between 0 and 900 seconds old. Training uses actual past closes captured now and is explicitly retrospective, not proof that price files or forecasts were available then.
causal_clocks.price_and_news: Current price and news have distinct clocks: price can be as old as 900 seconds, news evidence at most 300 seconds, with earlier original veto expiry retained. Their interaction is a same-decision joint feature, not a claim of simultaneous arrival.

model_transform.intercept_and_ridge: Prepend an intercept of 1 (35 design columns, not a 35th feature). beta solves (D^T D+diag(0,50,...,50)) beta=D^T y. The intercept is unpenalized. Coefficients are fitted jointly, not preset price/news conversion multipliers.
model_transform.matched_price_only: Fit a separate 24-feature Ridge model on exactly the same training anchors/targets as the joint fit. This is a comparator, not a component to add to the joint news-ablation difference.
model_transform.neutral_news_ablation: Use the same fitted joint coefficients, means, scales, shrinkage and joint sigma, unchanged current price features, and raw news=(0,0,0,1,0,0,0,0). Recompute products (both zero), then normalize. Joint expected minus this neutral-news expected is a model sensitivity/ablation difference, not causal news impact.
model_transform.not_inputs: Target pips, probabilities, fitted coefficients, expected returns, spread/costs, quote-entry outcomes, source health, model scores and dashboard pair labels are not additional columns in this 34-input vector. All order/promotion/proof flags remain false.
model_transform.return_shrinkage: For N training rows, effective=N/4 is an overlap-adjusted count heuristic, shrink=effective/(effective+20). sigma=max(0.1,residual_population_std,std(y))*sqrt(1+query_leverage+1/max(effective,1)). Final expected pips=clip(raw_query_prediction*shrink,-2*sigma,2*sigma). Neither this heuristic nor numerical readiness demonstrates calibrated prediction.
model_transform.training_bounds: Price capture reads a stable local CSV tail bounded to 4 MiB and 4096 rows. News reconstruction has a 48-hour committed-visibility range, 5000-row limit and explicit byte limits; violations fail closed. Model accepts at most 256 news anchor frames. Retained rows and correlated/overlapping labels are not independent sample counts.
model_transform.training_readiness: Current W(t) must have >=8 actual returns and >=900 seconds span. Training requires >=48 mature exact-H1 anchors, >=12 context-nonempty rows and >=8 distinct four-field context patterns. If a vetted training dimension has std<1e-9 and its current value differs from the historical constant by >1e-9, fitting is blocked as unseen vetted input.
model_transform.training_standardization: Construct every raw feature, including both products, before normalization. For each training column j, mean_j=mean_i(x_ij), scale_j=population std_i(x_ij). Set scale_j=1 if scale_j<1e-9. Fit on z_ij=(x_ij-mean_j)/scale_j and transform the current query with those same training-only values. No query value enters the fitted mean or scale. Thus the model consumes standardized dimensionless numbers even when raw features have pips/minute or hours units.

naming_and_order.exact_source_order: For windows 1,5,15,30,60 minutes, append (rate,span/minutes,1-density,float(not available)); then append RMS elapsed change, max gap, len(current)/61, session age; then NEWS_FEATURES tuple; then technical[0]*news[0], technical[0]*news[4].
naming_and_order.feature_id_policy: Stable documentation IDs. The eight news IDs exactly equal NEWS_FEATURES. The 24 price and two interaction IDs are documentation-assigned names for unnamed positional entries, not claimed existing code symbols.
naming_and_order.static_reconstruction_method: Read PARAMETERS['feature_windows_minutes'], the _features loop/extend calls, NEWS_FEATURES and _joint_features. This dictionary does not import or execute them. Their sequence is the expected ordering for independent AST-only validation.

shared_definitions.news: e is the news frame evaluation epoch. C is the selected pair's context member list, V its vetted guarded-claim list. A member/group is pair-relevant if either currency key exists in its score map. An absent base or quote key is treated as score 0 only after pair relevance is established.
shared_definitions.pip: pip is the registered pair pip size, validated as one of 0.0001, 0.001 or 0.01 by the numeric source. Returns in pips divide price-unit differences by pip; positive means the base/quote rate rose.
shared_definitions.price: P(u) is the positive finite close field from the selected instrument's captured M1 CSV. The parser verifies instrument/granularity/complete flags if those columns exist, monotonically increasing exact minute starts, captured-byte hashes and u+60<=actual observation. It does not establish whether close is bid, ask or midpoint; that meaning is an upstream data contract, not inferred here.
shared_definitions.time: t is a UTC M1 start epoch. S(t) is the first retained row in the current session, reset only when an adjacent observed gap is greater than 1800 seconds. W(t) contains actual epochs from max(S(t),t-3600) through t inclusive. T_w is the suffix of W(t) with epochs >=t-60w. No prior-left-edge interpolation is used.
shared_definitions.window_notation: n_w=|T_w|, d_w=(last(T_w)-first(T_w))/60, available=(n_w>=2), density=(n_w-1)/w. The anchor always exists, so T_w is nonempty. A complete w-minute window has w+1 closes and w intervals.
shared_definitions.zero_not_absence: No single numerical zero establishes that news or price data is absent. A price rate can be truly flat or unavailable; a news score can cancel; a news count of zero is conditional on the narrow scored-member projection. Empty context is encoded (0,0,0,1) and empty vetted evidence as (0,0,0,0). Invalid/stale/unverifiable snapshots are rejected, not silently converted to neutral.

upstream_news_mapping.classifier_boundary: Source title/allowed summary, extracted/issuer-bound currencies, structured release metadata, policy/risk/commodity/intervention/reported-move rules and guards determine currency_scores. These are bounded rule-generated currency hypotheses, not pips. The inspected score assembly adds monetary impulse to subject currencies, 0.65*activity direction, haven/risk-currency risk adjustments, oil-exporter/JPY oil adjustments and intervention scores; then guards can remove or zero directions. This is a traced boundary, not a complete taxonomy of every upstream parsing branch.
upstream_news_mapping.classifier_score_rules: The inspected core score finalization retains abs(score)>=0.05 and rounds clamped [-1,1] scores to six decimals. Subsequent guards include absence of causal pre-release consensus for structured numeric releases, narrative/non-catalyst/expectations context, issuer/subject currency restriction and conflicting semantic directions. The returned currency_scores is the value actually consumed; standalone research_currency_scores is not substituted.
upstream_news_mapping.context: The joint frame selects members with nonempty valid currency_scores, known_m<=e, known_m>=e-3600 and availability<=e. It deduplicates by normalized headline before selecting the pair. C contains selected members with either pair currency key. It does NOT require each context member to pass directional timeliness, corroboration or other directional guard checks. No source-quality weighting or time decay is applied in the four context aggregates. This is scored-member context, not all news text.
upstream_news_mapping.limitations: Original v164/v165 classifications can differ in the historical archive; historical snapshots preserve their original classifications. Context headline deduplication is global to the frame and not a count of independent publishers. Existing source/classifier availability does not prove predictive usefulness, source completeness, or semantic correctness.
upstream_news_mapping.not_consumed: The 34-vector does not directly consume headline text/tokens/embeddings, generic_sentiment_score, risk_off_score/risk_on_score, monetary_impulse, research_currency_scores, category one-hots, source_quality/confidence as extra scalar columns, all raw releases, dashboard directional labels, price reaction outcomes or peer-pair features. Some affect the original currency_scores or guarded eligibility upstream; many remain outside this projection.
upstream_news_mapping.producer: classify_article produces original member currency_scores. The producer later publishes guarded current topic evidence through build_current_news_snapshot(published_relevant, as_of=completed), attaches three producer source hashes and a generated clock, then writes joint_news_current_v1.json. The joint adapter independently validates/replays this artifact rather than reading the dashboard's pair_sentiment_latest.json.
upstream_news_mapping.same_claim: Exact normalized headlines match but cannot independently corroborate. Otherwise negation sets and numeric token sets must agree; nonempty semantic-claim lists must share a canonical claim, or the fallback requires >=5 non-stopwords per headline and Jaccard word overlap >=0.8. This is a conservative implemented matching rule, not semantic truth verification.
upstream_news_mapping.vetted: The same selected members are greedily grouped when each new member satisfies same_claim with every existing member. guard_topic evaluates each group at e. Every representative must have its own current clocks, forward_signal_timely true, publication-arrival lag within its 0..30-minute limit, unexpired original 1..1440-minute horizon, valid nonzero score map and valid quality/confidence. Context/prior-move/bootstrap/research-only and related flags exclude directional admission. Duplicate IDs invalidate support; repeated publishers or exact syndicated headlines collapse. Coherence and either >=1 source_verified member or >=2 independent representatives are required.
upstream_news_mapping.within_claim_scores: For each currency c, use w_i=max(0.1,source_quality_i) only among representatives containing c, then v_j[c]=round(sum_i(w_i*c_i[c])/sum_i(w_i),6). Every claim is equally weighted in the later pair-level average regardless of its publisher count. Claim direction is discarded if all its currency scores cancel to zero. A claim with nonzero currency scores can still have zero pair difference when its two legs are equal.

analogous_live_base_helpers.historical_clock_caution: Feature timeframe controls base_minutes. Current resampling keeps bars with >=70% expected source count and requires >=60 resulting rows. This threshold is not an attestation of the original experiment's completed-bar timing.

analogous_live_base_helpers.range_position: For label60/240 set window=max(2,model_bars_for_minutes(label,base_minutes)); position=2*((close-rolling_min(close,window))/(rolling_max(close,window)-rolling_min(close,window))-0.5), zero width becomes NaN.
analogous_live_base_helpers.strength: enrich_live_model_rows uses median finite signed pair log returns per currency across rows supplied to that call (+base,-quote); strength_gap_H=base strength-quote strength. Currency ranks are index/max(1,currency_count-1), sorted ascending strength; strength_gap_rank_H=base rank-quote rank. It does not establish same-time point-in-time panel correctness by itself.

pd.concat(
        [
            (high - low).abs(),
            (high - previous_close).abs(),
            (low - previous_close).abs(),

        axis=1,
    ).max(axis=1) * multiplier

generation_recipe.calendar: calendar__hour_sin/cos = sin/cos(2*pi*integer UTC decision hour/24); calendar__day_of_week_sin/cos = sin/cos(2*pi*Monday-zero UTC weekday/7).

identities.currency_recipe: For each listed currency emit currency_base__CCY and currency_quote__CCY as separate 0/1 identity flags, not signed exposures.

generation_recipe.inherited_verified_recipe: For inherited original fields, source_function_locals and source_helpers in original_htf_227 resolve the exact C source assignments. Removing unsafe fields does not alter these equations.
generation_recipe.interaction_recipe: For each listed feature, multiply the two numeric-coerced inputs and cast float32; skip a term if either source column is absent. No fitted coefficient is embedded in an interaction.
generation_recipe.source_selection: Exact original feature order minus removed_unsafe_fields. The 270-column ARIMA alternative adds 50 candidate terms to 220 and was not the selected winner.

Helper-specific RSI and same-session baseline details are referenced, not replaced by guessed generic definitions.
No matrix or model was opened/recomputed; population and duplicate findings are read from the retained audit.

generation_recipe.activity_spread_recipe: log1p(volume), change in that log, historical ratios and z scores using shifted 120/min20 history; same-session activity baseline delegates to archived helper; return/log-activity correlation uses 60/min30. Spread value plus prior120/min20 median ratio/z score and ATR14/spread. Registry activity is historical candle volume, not verified order-book depth.
generation_recipe.ar_proxy_recipe: 60-bar lag-1/lag-2 autocorrelations form clipped [-3,3] AR2 phi terms. Forecast = phi1*r + phi2*r.shift(1). Innovation subtracts the prior, shifted-coefficient forecast. Uncertainty uses prior innovations over 60 bars, min 30. Seasonal autocorrelation uses lag M1=60, M30=48, H1=24, H4=6; window max(60,4*lag), minimum max(30,2*lag). These are causal AR proxies, not separately fitted ARIMA models.
generation_recipe.calendar_recipe: time__hour_sin/cos use UTC minute-of-day/1440. time__weekday_sin/cos use Monday-zero weekday/7.
generation_recipe.candle_indicator_recipe: Bar range/body in pips and body/wick fractions; true range=max(H-L,abs(H-Cprev),abs(L-Cprev))/pip, rolling mean ATR. RSI delegates to archived _rsi. SMA distance and EMA span distances; Bollinger z uses rolling close std. CCI uses typical-price mean then rolling mean of absolute deviations from that evolving mean (not an assumed textbook replacement). MACD uses EMA12-EMA26 and EMA9 signal. Stochastic and Williams values are source-defined unscaled range fractions.

cross_window_expansion.duplicate_caution: All five nominal 15-minute fields equal their 1-minute counterparts in every one of the 205,029 retained v4 rows, including matching nulls. m1__return_15_pips is absent. Duplicate data are directly proven; attribution to the archived v5 missing-window fallback is inference across versions.
cross_window_expansion.v5_recipe: Select m1__return_W_pips, otherwise return_lag_00_pips. Normalize by max(m1__atr_14_pips,0.1), clip [-10,10]. At the same decision timestamp, currency strength is mean signed currency-leg normalized return (positive base, negative quote); pair value is base minus quote. Rank is cross-pair percentile rank of normalized return; dispersion is its grouped sample std.

generation_recipe.lagged_return_recipe: For each timeframe, return_lag_LL_pips = (diff(completed close)/pip).shift(LL), exact LL=00..59.
generation_recipe.notation: Within each source timeframe: C/O/H/L = completed close/open/high/low; pip = native pip size; r = diff(C)/pip; replace zero denominators by NaN where stated in source. Final feature infinities become NaN and numeric columns float32.
generation_recipe.preprocessing: Retained source selects the exact numeric/categorical schema and uses median imputation for numeric fields; one-hot categorical identities add fitted dimensions. No fitted artifact was deserialized for this dictionary.
generation_recipe.provenance_boundary: Exact ordered names and historical counts are v4 registry evidence. The equations below document the retained archived v5 source of the same named transforms; they are not an attestation that this exact source generated the fitted v4 matrix.

recipes: (C-rolling W min(L))/(rolling W max(H)-rolling W min(L))

generation_recipe.source_context_recipe: source_gap_minutes = difference between completed source timestamps; weekend_or_data_gap flags gap > expected timeframe; bars_since_gap resets on any nonmatching expected gap. source_session delegates to archived UTC session code; source_sample_count is running observation index + 1.
generation_recipe.state_recipe: EMA8 and EMA32 level gaps and their difference in pips; residual divided by its rolling60/min30 std; gain proxy = EMA8(abs(diff(C)))/EMA32(abs(diff(C))).

recipes: rolling mean/std, current-return z score, skew and kurtosis (pandas defaults; full W observations)
binary sign entropy with probabilities clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6]
AR1 = rolling covariance(r,r.shift(1))/rolling variance(r.shift(1)), clipped [-2,2]; forecast = AR1*r

generation_recipe.timing: Timeframe prefixes are m1__, m30__, h1__, h4__. Use completed resamples and a backward as-of join allowing exact matches; the three higher frames add source_age_minutes = decision time minus source bar end.

engines.lookback: Exact registry expansion: 60 lagged one-bar returns (00..59) in each timeframe; return/range windows 2,3,5,8,13,21,30,60 source bars; statistical windows 5,15,30,60 source bars; ATR 5,14,30,60; RSI 7,14,30; SMA/EMA/Bollinger/CCI 20,60. EWM and recursive proxies depend on retained earlier history, not a hard finite cutoff.
engines.meaning: A shared multitimeframe numerical market-state row used for eight separately labeled midpoint-return endpoints. 771 technical/timeframe fields plus 20 cross-currency values and four calendar fields; instrument/base/quote are three additional categorical inputs whose one-hot model dimensions are not included in 795.
engines.name: Unified intrahour v4: 795 numeric plus 3 categorical identities
engines.units: Native pair pips for price changes/spreads and several statistical scales; dimensionless normalized values, fractions, ranks and indicators; minutes for source gap/age; counts for accumulated observations. Native pips across pairs are not comparable dollars.
validation_limits: Historical implementation evidence is not a current trading signal, production approval, or a fresh out-of-sample result.
795 fields were historically nonempty and nonconstant; 585 had some nulls, max 13,023/205,029 (~6.35%). These are retained audit observations, not current availability.
No news, macro, sentiment, order-book, position-book, microprice or depth fields occur in the 795 registry.
Retained mean direction accuracy 49.416%, relative MAE versus no-change 1.000914; forecast and after-cost gates failed.
The publisher requires passing forecast validation, matching artifact receipt and fresh snapshot; shadow emission does not separately require the after-cost gate. It grants no execution authority.
Native-pip ranking across pairs can favor exotic pip scales; horizon endpoints are not independent observations.

generation_recipe.aggregate_recipe: ma__scale_pips plus, for SMA and EMA, positive fractions of distances, three-bar slopes and pair ordering; mean/population std/range of normalized distances. ma__sma_ema_disagreement is fraction of valid period distances with differing positive signs. Helpers omit nonfinite entries and return NaN when none are valid.
generation_recipe.averages: SMA_p = rolling mean(p,min_periods=p). EMA_p = ewm(span=p,adjust=False,min_periods=p), equivalently recursive alpha 2/(p+1) seeded at first available close.
generation_recipe.expansion: P = BASE_PERIODS not exceeding the timeframe ceiling. Pair set = adjacent sorted P pairs UNION canonical pairs for which both periods exist; deduplicate and sort by (slow, fast). Emit 9 single-period fields per P, 10 fields per pair (five each SMA/EMA), then 14 aggregates. M1 has 21 periods and 44 pairs: 189+440+14=643.
generation_recipe.note: Canonical (12,26) is not emitted because 26 is not a BASE_PERIOD. Do not count every declared pair as present.
generation_recipe.pair_recipe: ma__pF_S__K_gap_scale=(MA_F-MA_S)/price_scale; velocity=diff(raw gap)/price_scale; acceleration=diff(normalized velocity); cross_age counts bars since a finite gap sign change (>=0 defines positive). cross_age_log=log1p(age); cross_support=sign(gap)/(1+age), zero counted positive.
generation_recipe.preprocessing: Retained grid report names median imputation + standard scaling + multioutput ridge; alpha 10. Validation fits separate output calibration. Structural feature names exclude return/oscillator/volume/book/account/vote inputs and spread (spread is used for executable cost outcomes).
generation_recipe.scale: abs(diff(close))/max(pip,1e-12), rolling20/min5 mean. Nonfinite/nonpositive scale fallback is median of positive finite scale values in the supplied array, else 0.1; lower bound 0.1. price_scale=max(0.1,scale_pips)*max(pip,1e-12). This whole-array fallback is explicitly documented, not assumed causal in early warmup rows.

generation_recipe.historical: At selected S5 indices i>=12, build exactly the 14 ordered columns below and exclude rows containing any nonfinite value. Historical volume and S5 high/low are actual input columns.
generation_recipe.live_difference: The live S1 engine samples midpoint changes every five seconds for volatility, uses the last30 one-second mids for range (not S5 highs/lows), uses quote version increments for activity (not candle volume), and UTC hour+minute excludes second fractions. It fills short missing S1 buckets with prior quote and zero activity up to configured 60-second gap; longer gaps clear history. These contracts require parity checks.
generation_recipe.normalization: Training means/scales standardize numeric inputs; scales below 1e-9 become 1. The saved ridge coefficients and intercept operate on this standardized vector. Formula reconstruction here does not load or fit them.
generation_recipe.target: Historical first S5 point at nominal future endpoint through endpoint+7 seconds; chronological splits purge horizon+7. This differs from an exact original-target H1 ledger.

inputs: Historical S5 midpoint close/high/low, bid/ask close, spread_pips, volume and UTC timestamps
Separate legacy live S1 quote grid and quote-update activity; not assumed identical to S5 historical candles
engines.lookback: Historical feature vector requires 13 S5 observations (nominal 60 seconds); trainer accepts first-to-last span 55..70 seconds. Live engine needs 61 points covering exactly 60 seconds.
engines.meaning: Compact pair-specific ridge return surfaces. 871 pair-specific plus 13 pooled TRY/JPY proxies give 884 parameter surfaces. Fast/balanced/strict are three execution-profile configurations per surface (2,652), not separately fitted feature engines.
engines.name: Second-ridge curves: 14 numerical inputs and 13 horizons
engines.units: Price changes, ranges and spread in native pips; ratio and cycle inputs dimensionless; activity in source observation counts.
validation_limits: All 13 horizon-wide weighted after-cost means were negative; 87 individual historical profile gates passed but overlap across shared surfaces/rows and are not 87 independent successes.
Lower95 used row standard error, not event/horizon-block dependence adjustment; profile gate decisions reused holdout.
Optional depth/cross/microstructure outputs produced elsewhere by the live engine are not additional inputs to this fitted 14-column ridge schema.
Historical quotes being filled in legacy code is a documented implementation behavior, not permission to invent missing current prices.

gaps: Upstream generation of copied cross-currency and raw-pattern vote fields is not reconstructed merely from their scalar names; see explicit per-field missing-definition status.

The exact 223-name list below is directly read from retained H1 metadata. All five horizons share the audited223 count; this dictionary does not assume count equality proves every fitted schema's name equality.

generation_recipe.calendar: utc_time_sin/cos = sin/cos(2*pi*(epoch%86400)/86400); utc_week_sin/cos = sin/cos(2*pi*(epoch%604800)/604800). Week phase is Unix-epoch modulo, not Monday-zero weekday.
generation_recipe.exposures: Sorted three-letter currencies observed in training instruments, 21 here. currency_exposure_CCY = +1 for base, -1 for quote, otherwise 0 (add both contributions).
generation_recipe.market_recipe: build_signal_vector maps input fields, computes technical features and rounds finite non-execution-only values to eight decimals. M1 ATR=max(0.1, source m1_atr14_pips or1); M5 ATR analogous with M1 fallback. Return fields divide stored pip changes by their frame ATR. EMA gap/slope and candle geometry divide price difference by pip and ATR. Direct copied cross fields preserve upstream semantics; optional book defaults are not proof of observed books.
generation_recipe.market_source_helper_boundary: Exact copied expressions below are the current C build_signal_vector adapter; private helper names retain their source semantics. Upstream copied cross/pattern inputs still need independent lineage.

market_source_locals.highs: [finite(value) for value in features.get("highs") or closes]
market_source_locals.histogram: [left - right for left, right in zip(macd, macd_signal)]
market_source_locals.lows: [finite(value) for value in features.get("lows") or closes]
market_source_locals.macd: [left - right for left, right in zip(macd_fast, macd_slow)]
market_source_locals.opens: [finite(value) for value in features.get("opens") or closes]
market_source_locals.volumes: [finite(value) for value in features.get("volumes") or [1.0] * len(closes)]

generation_recipe.normalization: Train-only means/std; std<=1e-8 becomes1. Standardize raw66+exposure21+cycle4, clip [-8,8]. Append abs(z) and z*abs(z) for each of the 66 market columns only (132 terms). Re-standardize and clip all223 again with train-only final statistics.
generation_recipe.selection: Per direct horizon use only training rows to retain fields with finite coverage >=0.90 and variance >1e-10 after train-median filling. Retained August 5 audit selected 65 market fields; source schema counts were M5=192, M15=190, M30=186, H1=190, H2=180.
generation_recipe.spread: If atr_m1_pips and live_spread_atr retained, append spread_pips_proxy = their product; market block becomes 66.

inputs: Retained features_zlib signal snapshots (not read from the database by this dictionary)
Historical own-pair technical indicators plus stored cross-currency strength/breadth/ranks
Instrument, origin timestamp and origin-time spread/ATR scale
engines.lookback: Retained market inputs use M1/M5/M15/H1 series, 7/8/9 moving averages, 12/26/9 MACD, 2/5/15/30/60 M1 tick-volume-weighted windows and 14/20 indicator windows. Recursive EMA history and each upstream field's clock remain part of the source contract.
engines.meaning: Separate M5/M15/M30/H1/H2 regressions on origin-time stored signal vectors, with technical, nonlinear, signed currency-exposure and UTC cycle columns. Currency exposures here are not the pair/currency one-hot identities used by the 267/795 engines.
engines.name: Direct multihorizon currency panel: 223 final columns
engines.units: Source columns mix pips, ATR-normalized values, ratios/fractions and scores. Every final design-matrix column is train-standardized and clipped [-8,8], including the nonlinear terms after their expansion.
validation_limits: All full-history direct-panel selection blocks failed before holdout reporting and actual research decisions were no-trade.
Optional order/position-book numeric declarations in the producer have default-zero paths; they do not establish observed book history and do not appear among the retained65 market names here.

Direct executable long/short outcomes and currency-factor alternatives are distinct prediction targets; neither an observed move census nor a best-pair-per-horizon matrix is one pair's prospective curve.

historical.scope: Additive documentation only. Named historical D paths are provenance, never live dependencies. Read only retained audit metadata, registries and source text; no model fitting/deserialization, checkpoints loaded, dataset/database queries, runtime or execution changes.

scope: Documentation only; preserves design, code and historical evidence distinctions.
